bio.text: Carol Miller represents West Virginia's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which she was elected in 2018, and serves on the Committee on Ways and Means.
She served in the West Virginia House of Delegates from 2006 to 2018, where she became the first female Majority Whip.
She was born in Columbus, Ohio, lives in Huntington, and owns and operates Swann Ridge Bison Farm.
